observed: Four independent real-client sessions have a zero cached first-person model count before and after the pointer diagnostic. The third and fourth included eight serial reads. In r796, an existing weapon-78 queue item stayed at status zero and the weapon lookup entry first word stayed zero. This matches the branch condition that returns before model resolver; the exact queue producer/consumer and reason it remains pending are not yet established.

limits: Model cache count is not itself a renderer draw count. The r796 valid screenshot shows no arms or gun while AK-47/29 HUD is visible; clip change is diagnostic, not proof of real firing. Client-info root alternated zero/nonzero in serial reads, so a single sample of that root is not a conclusive cause.
